name: GSO controlled rendered-input normalized shape benchmark
normalization: Independently center each mesh at its axis-aligned bounding-box midpoint and divide all coordinates by that mesh's bounding-box diagonal. This removes absolute size and translation.
unaligned_pose: Identity between exported model +Y-up coordinates and reference +Y-up coordinates after independent normalization; no fitted rotation.
chamfer: half-sum of mean squared nearest-neighbor distances in both directions; also half-sum of unsquared distances
registration_initializations: All24proper signed-permutation rotation matrices, lexicographic flattened order
registration_fit: Untrimmed predicted-to-reference nearest-neighbor rigid Kabsch ICP; proper rotation, translation only, no reflection and no additional fitted scale
registration_selection: Smallest symmetric squared Chamfer on registration points across fixed24trials; first lexical trial wins ties
registration_interpretation: Supplementary shape after reference-assisted nuisance pose alignment, not absolute reconstruction accuracy
heldout_views: Four fixed reference cameras; normalized predicted meshes mapped back into reference maxextent1 coordinates. Report explicitly normalized/rigid-aligned supplementary silhouette IoU; no physical calibrated-model accuracy claim.
resampling_unit: object, preserving paired models; category-stratified shoe/backpack resampling
limitations: Real scanned references, but conditioning inputs are deterministic renders rather than real photographs
Lexically selected17shoes+3backpacks, predominantly ASICS shoes;4development objects excluded from test
Scale and translation removed independently; rigid pose may use reference geometry
Source texture and scan imperfections remain ground-truth limitations
